name: git-worktrees
title: Git Worktrees
summary: Establish an isolated, verified-clean workspace before starting implementation work.

use_when: Starting feature work that should not touch the user's current checkout
Setting up before executing an implementation plan
The user asks for a worktree or isolated workspace
avoid_when: Branch, commit, rebase, or history planning — use git-workflow
Stacked or dependent PRs — use gh-stack
Deciding how finished work is integrated or cleaning up afterwards — use branch-integration
